additional_info.subject: Request for Ticket Creation - Incident on Left Connector DC1 - Sicharge D Y2/S2 313522141001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am writing to report an incident with the left connector DC1 of the
Sicharge D Y2/S2 313522141001
charging station located at
PTS Dufour
, Rue des Chantiers, Le Havre.
Here are the details:
•
Issue reported:
The driver contacted us to report that the DC1 connector was unavailable despite several connection attempts, with the status showing as “unavailable.”
•
Last status update:
12/11/2024 at 19:47:19.
•
Impact:
The charging session could not start, preventing the
Volvo FM Electric
truck from being charged, while the DC2 connector was functioning correctly and continues to do so.
It is worth noting that this issue appears to be similar to another incident reported today at a different client’s site.
We request a thorough investigation to determine the root cause of this malfunction and implement the necessary corrective actions.
Please confirm that this ticket has been created and keep us updated on the progress of this request.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
